subject: Film & Cinema
title: Alfred Hitchcock: Master of Suspense
description: One-minute skill: Alfred Hitchcock: Master of Suspense.

hook.text: Hitchcock understood one thing perfectly: it's scarier to know the bomb is there than to see it explode.

buildup.text: Across five decades, he made suspense an art form — Psycho, Vertigo, Rear Window, The Birds.

discovery.text: He controlled every frame, storyboarding obsessively and treating the audience as his instrument.

twist.text: He was cruel to actors and manipulative in his personal life — genius came with darkness.

climax.text: Every thriller made since owes something to Hitchcock's understanding of fear.

punchline.text: He made the audience his accomplice.

quiz.question: What was Hitchcock's core filmmaking principle?
options: Suspense — letting the audience know the danger — is more powerful than surprise
